name: Coastal Cruisers
description: Live the Coastal Cruisers lifestyle, on and off the track.
story: Coastal Cruisers is a brand dedicated to the laid-back, adventurous spirit of coastal living. We see motorsport as the perfect platform to showcase our brand's values of freedom, excitement, and a connection to the outdoors. We are looking to partner with a team that embodies these qualities and can bring our message to a wider audience.
